S4.1-01.conflict: BOM_DETAILED.csv v7.0 specifies 600x450x150 mm (~120 kg) whereas canonical CAD params.py v6.0 specifies 900x700x120 mm (223 kg solid).
S4.1-01.decision: SELECTED 900x700x120 mm DIN 876/00 granite base plate with Ø420 mm (R=210 mm) central DR clear bore and 44x M6 threaded stainless inserts (~174 kg).
S4.1-01.justification: A 600x450 mm block cannot structurally support the Ø456 mm CF400 UHV bottom flange, the 820x620 mm S4.2-01 active 6-DOF isolation table, the metrology bridge footprint, and the S4.4-01 He-Ne laser shelf while preserving a clear R=210 mm bore. 900x700x120 mm spans all supports cleanly and clears the -X DR OVC (x_min=-450 mm > -475 mm).

S5.1-01.field: UHV main chamber inner radius & volume
S5.1-01.bom_v7_spec: r = 175 mm (~34 L, Exp80 s=0.5 envelope)
S5.1-01.engineering_rationale: Exp125 8-coil cryo-magnet outer former has OD = 352.0 mm (R = 176.0 mm). A BOM r = 175 mm wall would interfere by 1.0 mm; R_in = 182.0 mm provides 6.0 mm radial vacuum clearance (182 - 176 = 6.0 mm) while keeping V_in / V_ref = 34.91 / 269.39 = 0.1296 within Exp80 BC4 (1/8 +/- 5%).

S5.1-04.field: Magnetically coupled UHV transfer arm linear stroke
S5.1-04.bom_v7_spec: 500 mm linear stroke + 360 deg rotary with Ti-6Al-4V wafer fork
S5.1-04.cad_v8_adopted: Full 518.0 mm active stroke (570 mm magnetic guide tube, CF100 fork parking spool ID=98 mm clearing 68 mm Ti-6Al-4V yoke, X=510.5..1158.5 mm reaching X=-11.5 mm past wafer center X=0) replacing legacy CAD v6.0 200 mm stub.
S5.1-04.engineering_rationale: Load-lock center (X=420 mm) to main chamber wafer chuck (X=0 mm) requires 506.5 mm travel from parked fork center (X=506.5 mm); 518.0 mm unobstructed shuttle stroke reaches X=-11.5 mm (11.5 mm past wafer center) while staying <=1158.5 mm (>=21.5 mm clear of Rack Bay 1 at X=1180 mm).

S5.4-01.bom_v7_spec: 25x Dia 100 mm stock epitaxial wafers (100 nm epi, f=1.0% 29Si)
S5.4-01.cad_v8_adopted: Dia 50.0 mm x 0.775 mm laser-diced working wafer (SEMI M1 primary/secondary flats) seated at Z_WAFER = 500.00 mm on 80x80 mm AlN carrier.
S5.4-01.engineering_rationale: An undiced Dia 100 mm wafer with carrier frame cannot fit inside the Dia 150.0 mm Exp125 magnet clear bore or pass through the CF100 load-lock gate valve bore (Dia 101.6 mm). Laser-dicing Dia 100 mm CVD stock to Dia 50.0 mm working wafers yields 80x80 mm carrier diagonal = 113.14 mm (18.43 mm radial clearance to Dia 150 mm bore).
